vehicle.description: Worst case of a 2.4-3 MW onshore turbine: 45-55 m blade, ~4.3 m bottom tower section, 70-90 t nacelle

verdicts.label: Viable: nothing known against it, reachable from a port
To check: a bridge, curve, narrow or county road on this stretch
Blocked: a signed limit or ban stops the vehicle
Isolated: no port reaches it without a blocked road

reasons.label: Signed weight limit below 20 t (weak bridge or road)
Bridge with no known load capacity
County or local road (likely under 7 m wide)

caveats: A pre-screening, not a permit: every oversize convoy still needs a special transport authorisation (AST) from CNAIR, which sets the actual route.
OpenStreetMap rarely tags bridge capacity in Romania. A road with nothing against it may still have a weak bridge; bridges on secondary and county roads are flagged.
Curves are measured along each road; turns at junctions between two roads are not.
Temporary closures, roadworks and seasonal heavy-traffic bans are not included.
Roads smaller than county roads (the last kilometres to a site) are out of scope.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap road network of Romania (Geofabrik extract)
